Chiều dầy lớp trát trần nên trát dầy từ: The thickness of the ceiling plaster layer should be from 10 mm to 12 mm thick. If the plaster is thicker, there must be measures to prevent landslides by plastering on steel mesh or plastering in many thin layers.
Đối với trát tường, chiều dầy khi tô trá: For wall plastering, the thickness when plastering a normal flat wall should not exceed 12 mm, when plastering with high quality requirements, it should not exceed 15 mm, and when plastering with particularly high plaster quality requirements, it should not exceed 20 mm.

Plastering mortar lines should be carried out sequentially from top to bottom and from inside to outside to avoid unevenness. Industrial wood has many advantages in terms of aesthetics, durability and value, so it is widely used in the market today. MFC là viết tắt của Melamine Faced Chipb: MFC stands for Melamine Faced Chipboard, this is a Melamine-coated plywood board, widely used to make wooden furniture products in homes or offices. Currently, 80% of interior products on the market are often made from MFC, because of advantages such as rich colors and ease of production. MFC wood has the relatively cheapest price among industrial wood lines. MFC used to have very weak durability, but now this type of wood has had many changes in production to bring better quality.
Sau đây là 2 loại gỗ MFC: – MFC thường v: Here are 2 types of MFC wood: - Regular MFC and moisture-resistant MFC, the difference between these two materials is the green core, this is a combination of pressed wood chips and moisture-resistant glue, providing high moisture-proof and termite-reducing effects for this type of wood.
MDF được viết tắt bởi Medium Density Fib: MDF, abbreviated as Medium Density Fiberboard, seems to be the most popular material in the production of interior products for offices, homes, and businesses. Made from natural wood fibers mixed with resin and glue to create pressed wood that is durable and flexible, making it easy to cut during the production process. MDF wood also has the same financial benefits as MFC, and this material also comes in two types: regular and moisture-resistant. Therefore, customers need to consider their needs to choose the most suitable type.
HDF là một vật liệu ván ép công nghiệp c: HDF is an industrial plywood material called High Density Fiberboard. This is a wood material made from wood fibers bonded by resin under high pressure and temperature. This is a completely durable material, good bearing capacity, little warping. After finishing, HDF has a smooth surface, no wood chips and has a solid structure, overcoming most of the disadvantages of MFC and MDF.
Black HDF hay còn gọi là CDF (Compact De: Black HDF, also known as CDF (Compact Density Fiber Board), has the same structure and material as HDF but is produced with a compression pressure many times greater than HDF. This is a high-quality material line with a stable price, the optimal solution for the needs of products with high moisture resistance and termite resistance such as kitchen furniture and living room furniture. The easily visible feature is the black core, this is also an aesthetic advantage in construction.
Bên cạnh những vật liệu như MFC, MDF hay: Besides materials such as MFC, MDF or HDF, currently one of the names that furniture makers are interested in is Plywood - a type of plywood produced from solid wood panels about 3mm thick stacked on top of each other in many continuous layers in the direction of the wood grain. The layers of boards are bonded together with specialized glue and pressed under very high pressure of water. Outstanding advantages of this material line include:
Độ chịu nước cao (ngâm trong nước 72h vẫ: High water resistance (soaked in water for 72 hours still does not separate layers)
Chống nứt, uốn, cong vênh và co: Resists cracking, bending, warping and shrinking
Có thể làm từ hầu hết các loại gỗ để tăn: Can be made from most types of wood to increase aesthetics
WPB viết tắt của Water Proof Board là vậ: WPB stands for Water Proof Board, a new industrial material with the main material being PVC plastic with extremely high stability, anti-corrosion, especially absolute water resistance and slow flammability, safe in use and construction. This is absolutely the optimal wood replacement solution to meet current sustainable development needs. Protect the environment from toxic emissions in industrial wood production.
WPB còn có ưu điểm trong tạo màu, khả nă: WPB also has advantages in color creation and printing ability, making it an ideal material for use in the printing and advertising industry such as signs, interior and exterior decoration of shops and offices.

Lịch sử hình thành phong cách nội thất I: History of Indochine interior style formation.
Ngoài ra sự kết hợp giữa nét đẹp hiện đạ: In addition, the combination of modern beauty and modern French modern European interior style is tropicalized by local identity, suitable for the climate, ... in this style, it is extremely aesthetically pleasing.
Năm 1859, quân Pháp chiếm đóng thành Gia: In 1859, French troops occupied Gia Dinh citadel and paved the way for the establishment of French-style Indochina. At this time, the Cornett Act was passed. This code stipulated the rules, urban planning and development at that time with the purpose of adapting contemporary Western construction techniques to harmonize and suit the locality and climate in Vietnam.
Một kiến trúc sư, nhà khảo cổ học người: A French architect, archaeologist and Director of the Department of Architectural Planning of French Indochina named Ernest Hébrard is considered the father of the Indochine Style thanks to his clever and creative combination of materials and Eastern-European architecture of that time.
Phong cách Đông Dương trong thiết kế nội: Indochina style in interior design was initially served to the bourgeoisie and small townspeople, but later details were selected to represent Vietnamese national identity. Simple, sophisticated but still ensures full amenities in modern life to bring comfort and convenience to users.
Phong cách nội thất Indochine thường sử: Indochine interior style often uses neutral colors such as light yellow, cream yellow, white... dotted with warm colors that express the freshness, dynamism, and vitality of the tropics such as orange yellow, red, purple...
Không gian nội thất Indochine còn được t: Indochine's interior space is also equipped with items made of folk materials such as bamboo, wood, rattan, etc. materials associated with life and culture.
Với tính chất mềm, bền chắc,…gỗ còn được: With its soft, durable properties,...wood is also used as items in many projects such as door systems, flooring, ceilings, roof structural frames, decorative details such as reliefs, round statues,...
Do có khả năng chống mọt, chống mối tốt,: Due to its good anti-moth and anti-termite properties, climate compatibility and high durability, bamboo is used a lot in Indochina design style to make decorations, equipment, partitions, etc. to create beautiful, soft images.
Trong phong cách nội thất Indochine, gạc: In Indochine interior style, encaustic tiles and fired bricks are often used for flooring, creating a luxurious yet sophisticated beauty for the space.
Họa tiết hoa văn đã trở thành biểu tượng: Patterns have become a typical symbol of Indochina style in interior design and create unique qualities when applied to details such as floors, walls, ceilings, decorative items, partitions, interior equipment,...

Ảnh hưởng văn hóa Trung Quốc trong phong: Chinese cultural influence in Indochine interior style with rectangular motifs decorated with Chinese characters: Phuc, Loc, Tho, Hy. The lines are seamless, simple, interwoven and fit in one box or can also lie freely depending on the design.

Hiện nay việc thiết kế nhà ở kết hợp văn: Currently, the design of housing combined with offices brings convenience, in the trend of increasing economic development as in Vietnam, besides large enterprises, small and medium enterprises are also growing more and more.
Một số gia đình có mặt sàn rộng thường đ: Some families with large floors often have their company headquarters managed by members right in their homes. Some others intend to rent space, so they have come up with the idea of ​​​​designing a house combined with an office. So in building a house combined with an office, what are the differences compared to regular houses? To Am Hoan Hao's article below will help you understand better!
Tư vấn nhà ở kết hợp văn phòng: Consulting on housing combined with office
1. Luôn có tầng hầm/ trệt để gửi xe: 1. Always have a basement/ground floor for parking
Nhà ở kết hợp văn phòng hay nhà vừa ở vừ: Houses that combine offices or houses that are both residential and for rent often appear in big cities and areas with convenient transportation. The advantage of this house model that can be seen clearly is that it is designed in adjacent rows or high-rise buildings. Houses are often built with additional basements or semi-basements to make garages. The floors with apartments are designed to be self-contained. The rooftop area is also often used to create a drying yard or open cafes whose target customers are those staying in the building. Not only does it not cost money to rent space, but it can also generate profit.
Khi bạn xây dựng nhà ở kết hợp văn phòng: When you build a house combined with an office, it also means that the number of people going in and out can be up to several dozen to hundreds of people per day and having a place to store and preserve vehicles for passersby is a must. Depending on your needs and preferences, you can design the parking area in the basement or ground floor and don't forget to pay attention to ventilation as well as fire prevention in this area to ensure safety for the whole project.
2. Bố trí khu vực văn phòng phía dưới và: 2. Arrange the office area below and the housing area above
Đây là nguyên tắc bắt buộc trong việc xâ: This is a mandatory principle in building housing combined with offices. Normally, rental offices are arranged on floors 1-2-3-4, an area where employees as well as guests can easily get up and down and move around. On the contrary, the family's living area should be located on high floors, where quietness and privacy are required.
Thêm nữa, việc di chuyển của các thành v: In addition, the movement of family members up and down is often personal and has little impact on the offices below. It is this reasonable arrangement that balances the necessary and sufficient elements of a space that integrates two functions at the same time: office and home.
3. Xây dựng cầu thang máy kết hợp cầu th: 3. Build an elevator combined with stairs
Thiết kế nhà ở kết hợp văn phòng đối với: Designing a house combined with an office to build an elevator and a staircase in a house combined with an office not only brings convenience, minimizing human effort when necessary, but also increases the opportunity to choose each individual's method of transportation and opens the "door" to escape in bad cases.
Thông thường, cầu thang máy được bố trí: Normally, the elevator is arranged parallel to the stairs and located in a hidden corner of the house to take advantage of the floor space while ensuring ventilation. For elevators, you should choose a type with a tonnage of about 1 ton with a capacity equivalent to about 15 - 20 people.
4. Lưu ý đến hệ thống lưu thông gió và c: 4. Pay attention to the wind circulation system and trees
Vì công trình có tần suất hoạt động cao,: Because the building has a high frequency of operations, the flow of people going in and out and the number of people present regularly is quite large, so when designing, you need to pay special attention to the ventilation system to minimize stuffiness or odor congestion. Normally, the air intake door must have a larger area than the air outlet and if the air outlet is located at the top, the air door must be located below, close to the foot of the wall so that when the air circulates, we can feel the coolness.
Ngoài ra, vì đây là môi trường văn phòng: In addition, because this is an office environment, the presence of food odors is a taboo, so in the family's daily kitchen activities, always make sure to turn on the suction and deodorizing mode, ensuring the house is always airy, without odors, affecting the work of the office below.
Bên cạnh đó, để tăng thêm nguồn khí có l: Besides, to increase beneficial air sources and create a pleasant and relaxing feeling, do not ignore the arrangement of trees on the balcony of your project.
5. Thiết kế nguồn điện công suất lớn và: 5. Design of a large capacity and safe power source
Khi có thêm văn phòng làm việc thì công: When there is an additional office, the monthly electricity usage capacity of the house is often relatively large. If used beyond the allowed capacity, it will lead to continuous circuit breaker jumps, affecting the work of the office area or the electricity being too weak, not meeting usage needs. Therefore, when designing a house combined with an office, you need the advice of experts to ensure appropriate measurement of the amount of electricity used and build an electrical system capable of meeting needs, while ensuring absolute safety to ensure the risk of electric shock or fire.
6. Xây dựng thiết kế theo phong cách hiệ: 6. Build the design in a modern style and paint the exterior and interior in neutral colors
Nếu xây dựng nhà ở chỉ phục vụ cho gia đ: If you build a house that only serves your family, you can choose from many different design styles. However, if you use it as an office for rent or as an office for a family company, the modern, streamlined yet still elegant style is the number 1 choice because it is suitable for many different offices and many different forms of business.
Tương tự thế, để đảm bảo phù hợp với mỹ: Similarly, to ensure compatibility with the aesthetics of many people and businesses, you should choose elegant interior and exterior paint colors such as pastel blue, light cream, white, black, cream yellow... These are colors that are easy to coordinate with office furniture, and create a soothing feeling on the eyes, so they can satisfy many people and increase the chances of businesses choosing them for your family's projects.

Beautiful townhouse interior design and construction cannot lack skylights
Kiến trúc nhà Việt trước đây thường khôn: Vietnamese house architecture in the past did not often have skylights. But in the past 15 years, this design has appeared in almost all townhouses because of its outstanding advantages. With the current dense population, houses are built close together so there are often not many open spaces. That's why arranging airy doors and lighting when designing and constructing townhouse interiors becomes a problem. And the perfect solution to this problem is skylights.
Những lưu ý về thiết kế giếng trời khi t: Notes on skylight design when designing and constructing townhouse interiors
Trên thực tế, lợi ích giếng trời mang lạ: In fact, the benefits of skylights are more than just a solution to improve ventilation and increase natural light in the home. This is a special space in the house, which can become an impressive highlight to make the space more beautiful. Therefore, when conducting interior design and construction, absolutely do not ignore this position.
Để khai thác tối đa hiệu quả, giếng trời: To maximize efficiency, skylights are often placed in the middle of the house. When arranged there, the skylight has 3 sides: the side adjacent to the boundary wall - the side adjacent to the stairs, the hallway - the side adjacent to the function room. The central location helps attract visibility, while also making a visual impression. Investing carefully in skylight design will help beautify adjacent functional spaces such as the living room, kitchen, stairs, etc. However, not every house has a skylight in a central location and there are even designers who design more than one skylight.
Khi thiết kế giếng trời cần chú ý 3 vị t: When designing a skylight, you need to pay attention to 3 locations: the top of the well - the arrangement of the glass roof and the roof and iron frame system, the cross-floor wall area and the bottom of the well. On the top of the well you can decorate it with iron flowers and an impressive roof frame to create beautiful shadows on the wall. The walls can be decorated with hanging lights, climbing plants, etc. The bottom of the well can be decorated with a garden, dry garden or fish tank. This is a very suitable location for growing indoor plants because it attracts natural light. If you want your living space to become green and fresh, you cannot miss this location.
Thiết kế giếng trời khi thiết kế và thi: Skylight design when designing and constructing townhouse interiors must first ensure functionality and then consider decoration. Be careful not to decorate too complicated as it will affect the light and air for the whole house.

Oak wood with a moisture content of 20% is the most perfect for interior processing because at this level fungi harmful to wood cannot grow.
Gỗ sồi phải được qua quy trình xử lý chu: Oak wood must be processed professionally and carefully to achieve the best quality.

Tube houses are quite popular in recent years. This type of house has a narrow facade but has depth, so tube house design, especially interior design, requires ingenuity. When designing the interior of a tube house living room, you need to pay attention to the following issues:
Thiết kế dựa trên cấu trúc phòng: The design is based on the room structure
Trong những ngôi nhà ống, để tạo được mộ: In tube houses, to create a beautiful living room, first of all, the design needs to be based on the room structure. You should arrange large-sized furniture in the corner of the room, then arrange accessories next to it. Once you have room for important furniture, you can be creative with how to arrange and decorate your living room space so that it is harmonious and beautiful without taking up much space.
Khó khăn mà mọi người hay gặp khi thiết: The difficulty that people often encounter when designing the interior of tube house living rooms is because they are long and narrow. However, if you know how to choose the highlight, the space will become more airy and spacious without being affected by that defect. The coordination of each interior item needs to be in harmony with each other, otherwise it will be counterproductive.
Ví như chọn bộ sofa với màu sắc nổi bật: For example, choosing a sofa set with colors that stand out against the bright background of the living room, or choosing throw pillows with unique, clear patterns to enliven the room are ideas for choosing smart accents. Your eyes will no longer pay attention to the narrowness of the space but will pay more attention to the prominent highlights. Besides, you can choose the highlight as the wall behind the TV, the wall hanging behind the sofa or the window curtain.
Phân tách từng khu vực phòng trong không: Separating each room area in space is also a way to creatively increase space. The apartment layout divided through each functional area will show the appeal of the apartment. According to the length of the room, you can divide it into a reading area, reception area and an empty area for children's play activities if the family has small children.
Làm sao để thiết kế nội thất phòng khách: How to design a beautiful tube house living room interior while still ensuring convenient and spacious moving space is not easy. But as long as you pay attention to a few points in the layout, you can easily solve this problem. Reasonable interior layout always leaves a comfortable path for the living space to make all activities in the apartment more convenient and easier.
Tạo lối đi giữa sofa và bàn trà, lối đi: Create a path between the sofa and the tea table, a path between the TV shelf and the tea table for easy movement, and do not place any furniture, even the smallest, on the path to ensure easy movement. Creating a sufficient path like this helps the distance from the sofa to the TV be far enough to enjoy comfortable entertainment moments without adversely affecting the homeowner's eyes and body.

Even if you don't know anything about architecture or interior design, the article below with basic principles will provide you with knowledge about modern bedroom interior design.
Thiết kế nội thất phòng ngủ hiện đại phả: Modern bedroom interior design must be breathable
Đối với phòng ngủ thì việc yêu cầu quan: For the bedroom, the most important requirement is ventilation. In the air there is 21% oxygen and 78% nitrogen, this content is always stable. But in a closed bedroom, the oxygen content will gradually decrease and the carbon dioxide content will increase. This Carbonic gas is very harmful to the nervous system, causing many people to not sleep well and also feel tired.
Để giảm thiểu khí Carbonic thì căn phòng: To minimize carbon dioxide, the bedroom, no matter how beautiful, must still be well ventilated so that the air can circulate well in the room. Especially nowadays, many bedrooms are equipped with air conditioners but forget about fans and ventilation equipment. This reduces the amount of oxygen in the room. You should make a vent and have an exhaust fan to ensure air always circulates.
Thiết kế nội thất phòng ngủ hiện đại với: Modern bedroom interior design with low temperature
Ngoài yếu tố thông thoáng ảnh hưởng đến: In addition to ventilation factors that affect sleep and health, the temperature in the bedroom is also quite important for your sleep time.
Nếu thiết nội thất phòng ngủ quá bí bách: If the bedroom interior design is too cramped or too greedy to arrange all the furniture in the room, the temperature will be lower and lower. The lower the temperature, the faster the body falls asleep.
Trong trường hợp nhiệt độ quá thấp, cơ t: In case the temperature is too low, the body will fall into a deep sleep, become lethargic, have difficulty waking up, and when you wake up you will be tired.
Chính vì vậy, khi thiết kế nội thất phòn: Therefore, when designing modern bedroom interiors, you need to pay attention to the temperature factor. Instead, it is also possible to design a 2-way air conditioner in the room to adjust the temperature accordingly.
Thiết kế nội thất phòng ngủ hiện bằng mà: Bedroom interior design is shown in gentle colors
Phòng ngủ là phòng nghỉ ngơi, bởi vậy kh: The bedroom is a resting room, so when designing a modern bedroom interior, it does not need to be too colorful and sophisticated. Light colors like white, gray, gray white, light yellow bring a pleasant feeling when you lie in the room. Psychologically, light colors provide a calming neurological feeling, quickly lulling you to sleep through minimizing your heart rate and breathing.
Thiết kế nội thất phòng ngủ hiện đại lưu: Modern bedroom interior design for easy circulation
Khi thiết kế nội thất phòng ngủ cần chú: When designing the bedroom interior, you need to pay attention to the convenience of going out to live or go to the toilet. Because when going to bed, the need to go to the toilet is inevitable and it is difficult to get up while sleeping to run a long distance to go to the toilet.
Tuy nhiên, thiết kế phòng ngủ gần phòng: However, the design of the bedroom near the bathroom needs to avoid odors and dampness, so the bedroom needs to be placed at the windward end.
Nếu như phong cách thiết kế hiện đại và: If the modern and robust design style leans toward simplicity and convenience in use, a luxurious and elegant bedroom focuses on elaborate, sophisticated decorative details that highlight the nobility of the owner.
Sự phối kết hợp một cách hài hòa giữa mà: The harmonious combination of wallpaper color, black wooden furniture and decorative details such as patterns, floor carpets... exudes solemnity and politeness. However, to design a classic villa interior without making cheesy or cumbersome mistakes, you need to absolutely pay attention to the following issues:
Không tuân thủ nguyên tắc đăng đối: Failure to comply with posting rules
Trong nội thất cổ điển, nguyên tắc đăng: In classical interiors, the principle of symmetry is considered an essential and immutable principle. Details from the ceiling to the patterns on the interior items are designed to be balanced and harmonious, creating a solid balance. They all go together in pairs, without any individual, "redundant" details.
Những gam màu trầm như nâu đất, tím, xan: Dark colors such as brown, purple, green... if used too much in one space will make your villa heavy and dark. Nếu như phong cách hiện đại yêu thích sự: If modern style loves minimalism, classic style loves meticulousness and sophistication. However, you should not be greedy and arrange too much furniture in the house, nor should you choose items and decorations that are too cumbersome and multi-detailed. Sophistication and harmony will bring beauty to your home, don't be too passionate about showing off details.
Sử dụng nhiều các vật dụng nội thất mạ v: Use a lot of gold-plated interior items
Các vật dụng nội thất viền, mạ kim loại: Bordered, metal-plated furniture items such as mirrors, sofas, tables... are often used in classic interior spaces, exuding luxury and nobility. However, you should not use too much of this type because it will make you feel like all the furniture is "painted yellow", very unaesthetic. Only spiritual places such as temples and pagodas prefer this type of interior.
Sử dụng các loại chất liệu quá nặng nề c: Using materials that are too heavy for curtains

Màu trắng là màu chủ đạo của phong cách: White is the main color of Scandinavian style. You can use white for the ceiling and wall areas to erase the intersecting lines, making the space seamless and helping to "cheat" the clear height of the space.

The importance of consulting on interior design of small apartments
Không giống với những căn hộ chung cư có: Unlike large apartments, small apartments are quite difficult to arrange and decorate furniture appropriately. However, many people mistakenly think that small things will be decorated, so they do not go to architects for advice and start working on it themselves. And then that mistake turned their apartment into a "disaster". That is why consulting on interior design of small apartments has recently been well received by many customers and considered this to be extremely important.
Những lưu ý khi tư vấn thiết kế nội thất: Things to note when consulting on interior design of small apartments
Trước khi bắt tay vào trang trí đồ nội t: Before starting to decorate furniture for small apartments, architects must inform customers of the necessary notes during the construction process because this is a very important job.
Chọn màu sơn là việc nên làm đầu tiên tr: Choosing paint color is the first thing to do in the interior design process for small apartments. Do not choose dark or too prominent colors because they will make your already small apartment even smaller. Using bright colors is the most reasonable choice, the apartment area will be increased by a few parts. Besides, you should also limit using too many colors because they will confuse anyone's eyes when entering, making them feel like they are in a messy apartment.
Lựa chọn rèm cửa tưởng như là một việc l: Choosing curtains may seem like an unnecessary task for small apartment interior design, but in fact it is very useful. When choosing a curtain with a color that contrasts with the house paint color, people will be attracted to the curtain and forget the inherently cramped space, creating a feeling of spaciousness and comfort. You should choose curtains with few patterns so that they integrate with the apartment area while helping the apartment exude a luxurious and modern look.
Hạn chế sử dụng tường ngăn cách vì khi s: Limit the use of dividing walls because when using dividing walls, your apartment space becomes smaller. Instead of designing fixed walls, you should use partitions, such as bookcases, to divide the space in the house, thus creating space and making the apartment eye-catching.

Definition of apartment building and apartment interior design
Cụm từ thiết kế kế nội thất nhà chung cư: The phrase apartment interior design is being commonly used today, however, there are still many people who do not clearly understand what an apartment building is, leading to incorrect apartment interior design. Therefore, in order for customers to be able to design the interior of an apartment appropriately, the definition of an apartment building was born. Accordingly, an apartment building is described as a house with four or more floors, with walkways, stairs and a common infrastructure system for many households and individuals. An apartment building has private ownership (indoor area, balcony) and common ownership (play area, yard, stairs...) of all households and individuals in that apartment building. For countries with dense, developed urban populations such as China, Vietnam..., apartment buildings are considered the number one solution for housing policy.

Principles of kitchen interior design for apartments
Thời gian gần đây, bên cạnh phòng khách,: Recently, besides the living room and bedroom, families also pay a lot of attention to the interior design of the kitchen because this is not only the space where the family lives during meals but also the place where everyone gathers and happily chats. Một số lưu ý bắt buộc phải nhớ khi thiết: Some notes are required to remember when designing the kitchen interior
Không để gương chiếu vào bếp: Do not let mirrors shine into the kitchen
Cũng giống phòng ngủ, gương là vật trang: Just like the bedroom, mirrors are taboo decorations. Homeowners can still hang mirrors in the kitchen, but they absolutely cannot shine directly into the kitchen because this will bring bad luck to the family.
Phòng bếp phải luôn thông thoáng: The kitchen must always be airy
Phòng bếp được xem là khu vực chứa nhiều: The kitchen is considered an area containing a lot of positive energy, attracting good fortune for the family. Therefore, in order for good air flow to circulate throughout the apartment, the kitchen must always be airy and clean. For apartments with small areas, ventilation fans must be installed to regulate airflow.
Theo ngũ hành, thủy tượng trưng cho màu: According to the five elements, water represents black and blue, and the kitchen represents fire, so the kitchen should avoid these two contrasting colors. If you intentionally paint, your family's fortune will be very unlucky.
Sắp xếp hệ thống nước và bếp thuận chiều: Arrange the water and kitchen systems in the right direction
Vòi nước và bếp không nên đối diện nhau: The faucet and the stove should not face each other because according to feng shui, the water energy produced by the water system and the fire energy created by the fire in the stove are inherently incompatible. If the faucet and the stove are opposite, it will have a negative impact on the homeowner. The best way is to arrange the kitchen faucet in the right direction.

Therefore, when designing the bedroom interior, in addition to the requirements of beauty and convenience, it is necessary to pay attention to a few issues to avoid violating taboos and negatively affecting the homeowner.
Giường đối diện trực tiếp với cửa phòng: The bed directly faces the bedroom door
Theo phong thủy, nơi cửa ra vào có luồng: According to feng shui, the entrance door has a very strong and direct flow of energy, so if you arrange the bedroom in this position, the strong and always moving energy flow from the door will have an impact, causing difficulty sleeping or many other causes of illness for you.
Trong trường hợp không còn cách nào khác: In case there is no other way to place the bed, create a mobile partition between the room door and the bed, or arrange a low cabinet hugging the bed to create a space to block this constantly moving air flow.
Gương không nên đối diện với giường, sẽ: The mirror should not face the bed, it will cause restless sleep, restless sleep, and nightmares.
Điều hòa đặt ngay đầu giường: The air conditioner is located right at the head of the bed
Có khá nhiều khách hàng không chú trọng: There are quite a few customers who do not pay attention to the details of installing air conditioners in the bedroom and often leave them right in front of the bed. However, in reality this is a serious mistake, causing negative impacts on the homeowner's health. If the bed is placed under the air conditioner, negative or cold air blowing directly down will disrupt the inherent balance of the "air field" that surrounds the body, affecting the body's metabolic function, causing the body's immunity to decrease, often leading to the flu or arthritis.
Để quá nhiều cây xanh trong phòng: Leave too many plants in the room
Cây xanh có thể khiến cho không gian tro: Green plants can make the indoor space more airy and closer to nature. However, if there are too many trees, it can be dangerous, especially at night, when trees emit a lot of CO2 gas that is harmful to health. Mẫu thiết kế kiến trúc độc đáo của nhà s: Unique architectural design of Indonesian stilt houses
Indonesia và Việt Nam có khá nhiều nét t: Indonesia and Vietnam have many cultural similarities, but they are so similar that a tribe in Indonesia maintains a stilt house style identical to the drawings on Dong Son bronze drums in Vietnam, surprising many people.
Những hình khắc trên nhiều chiếc trống đ: The engravings on many Dong Son bronze drums in Vietnam show the image of a type of stilt house with a curved roof like the two ends of a boat. There are two pillars at both ends of the house and in the middle there is a ladder to get to the floor. Historical data about this type of stilt house in Vietnam is almost non-existent. However, an ethnic group in Indonesia still maintains a stilt house style identical to the drawings on Dong Son bronze drums. That is the Toraja ethnic group living on the Indonesian island of Sulawesi.
Những ngôi nhà sàn ở Indonesia được gọi: Stilt houses in Indonesia are called Tongkonan. Tongkonan's main materials are wood, bamboo, and cane, glued together without nails. The body of the house is built on wooden pillars like the stilt houses of Vietnamese ethnic minorities. The highlight of this project is that the two ends of the roof are elongated and curved, making the house look like a boat.
Theo một truyền thuyết, tổ tiên người To: According to a legend, the ancestors of the Toraja people came to the island of Sulawesi from the North by wooden boats. Due to a big storm, they stopped in this land and used the boat as a shelter. That is the origin of tongkonan houses.
Tongkonan được xây dựng với ý nghĩa như: Tongkonan was built as a family and ancestral house, a place for ceremonies and meetings of family members, not a place to live. The Toraja people live in simpler houses called banua, located not far from tongkonan.

Điều cấm kỵ trong phong thủy khi sử dụng: Taboo in feng shui when using wall clocks
Đồng hô treo tường là một sản phẩm quen: Wall clocks are a familiar product and seem indispensable in any family. However, not everyone knows how to hang wall clocks correctly to avoid disadvantages for members. Most Vietnamese people often choose a random location in the house to hang it, but that affects each person's health and destiny.
Không nên treo đồng hồ trong phòng ngủ h: Do not hang clocks in the bedroom or office. Basically, hanging clocks in these two places does not have any positive feng shui effects. If you don't know how to hang it in the wrong direction, it can cause harm to the whole family. For example, in the bedroom, do not hang it at the head or foot of the bed, it will cause negative thoughts. In the office, you should not hang the clock on the desk because it will create a feeling of frustration and easily cause stress.
Theo phong thủy hiện đại, tiếng kim đồng: According to modern feng shui, the sound of clock hands and the sound of the hour alarm has a good effect, increasing excitement and freshness for the whole family. Regular, disciplined cries will help make family life more cohesive and joyful. That's why keeping the clock in the living room is most appropriate. However, it should be noted that the clock should not be placed in the direction facing the living room door, as it will cause guests to have bad luck and affect the homeowner's social relationships.
Mỗi gia đình cũng chỉ nên treo một đồng: Each family should only hang one clock in the living room. If there is too much, it will cause disturbances in the air in the house, from bad to good. At the same time, you should not leave decorative objects around the clock, otherwise it will change the good fortune of the whole family.
